$comment: Pre-committed relabel-sample selection rule (#98, DA2/#51, spec §6). The RULE and the SALT are committed here, now; MEMBERSHIP is deliberately not computed or shipped in this file -- #47 (labelling) has not completed, and DA2 requires membership to be derivable only after the full labelled leaf population exists, so a labeller cannot know in advance which leaves are being watched. The salt below is committed in CLEARTEXT and is not a secret: its purpose is to fix the ranking in public BEFORE any leaf exists, so no analyst can mint a salt at analysis time that selects a flattering sample. What keeps membership unknown during labelling is the missing population, not secrecy.
rule: The relabel sample is the lowest 10% of labelled leaves by sha256(relabel_salt || paper_id || question_id), computed within stratum, proportional to stratum size (rounded UP, so no non-empty stratum is starved to zero). No RNG or seeded shuffle is used anywhere in the selection.
rule_deviation_from_DA2: DA2 writes the rank as sha256(relabel_salt || question_id). That assumes question_id identifies a leaf; it does not -- leaf identity is (paper_id, question_id) per DA6, and lemely/eval/analyses.py has always used that pair. Under DA2's literal formula every paper's '1a' would share one rank and enter or leave the sample as a block, which is neither a 10% sample nor a per-leaf one. The full leaf identity is hashed instead, components joined with a NUL that cannot appear in a validated identifier. NOTHING HAS BEEN SAMPLED UNDER EITHER FORMULA (#47 has not completed), so no committed membership changes -- but this is a deviation from a human-recorded decision and is flagged here for ratification rather than applied silently.
stratification_note: Two authorising records disagree on the stratification axis: DA2 / the 2026-08-19T01:05 inbox item specifies the full 3-axis DA1 stratum (syllabus code x parse path x tariff band); the 2026-08-25T14:41:54 authorisation specifies mark-band-only (1 / 2 / 3+), proportional. This manifest implements the later, more specific reading (mark-band-only). The axis is an explicit single-place parameter in lemely/eval/sample_manifest.py (_stratum_by_mark_band, passed as select_relabel_sample's stratify_by argument) so switching to the full 3-axis stratum is a one-line change, not a rewrite -- flagged here rather than silently resolved, per the issue's own instruction.
leaf_population_reference: 9,464 true leaves in three populated mark bands (1: 4,559 / 2: 2,742 / 3+: 2,163), no fourth band, no exclusions. Recorded for context only -- this manifest does not itself enumerate or read that population, and no membership is derived from it here.
leaf_population_sources: BUILD/accuracy-runs/census-2026-08-24-a/manifest.json -- the measurement these counts come from (250 det-parsed schemes); by_tariff_band carries 1/2/3+ = 4559/2742/2163 and da1_strata.populated_counts sums to 9,464.
